name: BrowseComp-Plus
measures_ja: BrowseComp の難問を、固定された文書コーパスだけを検索して解けるか(検索器とエージェントを切り分けて比べる)。
harness_ja: 運営の標準足場(検索ツールが上位5文書を返す)で走らせた行と、提出者独自の足場の行が混在する。検索器(Retriever)も行ごとに違う。
notes_ja: system は「LLM + Retriever」を連結したもの。agent は Scaffold 欄の名前で、空欄はボードの表示どおり Standard。校正誤差が「-」の行はボードでは0と表示されるが、元CSVに従い値を入れていない。

rows.agent: AI21 custom scaffold: multi-agent setup coordinating up to 8 agents. Agents had access to `search` and `get_doc`
Sail Research custom scaffold: Searcher returns k truncated documents. Multi-agent swarm reports positive signal to harness, extending documents when needed
Search with get_doc: standard `search`, `get_document` (view full doc by id, avg. 3.20 calls this run)
Question’s Gambit scaffold: LLM expanded search for first-query, followed by standard `search` afterwards.
Search with get_doc: standard `search`, `get_document` (view full doc by id, avg. 3 calls this run)
Search with get_doc: standard `search`, `get_document` (view full doc by id, avg. 2.97 calls this run)
Search with get_doc: standard `search`, `get_document` (view full doc by id, avg. 2.11 calls this run)
openJiuwen custom setup: Multi-agent scaffold. Retrieved results are chunked; only most relevant chunks are returned in search, instead of truncating the full document by 512 tokens

Agentica custom scaffold: Allows agents to execute arbitrary code in a REPL. Agents had access to `search` and `get_doc_by_id` (avg. 8.83 calls this run) functions. `search` returned top 200 results instead of 5 in Standard scaffold. The submitter calculated recall using docs that the agent fetched using `get_doc_by_id`, due to the high top k used in `search`.
Search with get_doc: standard `search`, `get_document` (view full doc by id, avg. 2.50 calls this run)
